mapper.sql: t.id, t.name, t.type, t.threshold, t.discount, t.total_count as totalCount, t.per_user_limit as perUserLimit, t.valid_type as validType, t.valid_days as validDays, t.start_time as startTime, t.end_time as endTime, t.scope_type as scopeType, t.apply_category_id as applyCategoryId, t.apply_product_ids as applyProductIds, t.status, t.create_time as createTime, t.update_time as updateTime
mapper.delete: update coupon_template set status = 0, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select from coupon_template t where t.id = #{id}
